checks.name: Output Structural and Formatting Non-Conformance
checks.definition: An agent emits an output that fails to follow required structural, syntactic, or formatting specifications at the edge of execution, such as using invalid section headers or failing to format structural entries properly.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an agent's output formatting fails structural or formatting constraints specified in its contract (e.g., incorrect markdown headers or malformed delimiter syntax).
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the output contains factual errors while adhering to formatting constraints, or when the agent emits an incorrect functional payload type (e.g., producing an answer instead of a query).
